title: Top exterior power is invertible
statement: the top exterior power of a finite locally free sheaf is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf.

proof.text: Construct the local map from the local splitting and exterior-power basis statements, then glue it by sheaf extensionality and separatedness.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_top_isInvertible {X : Scheme.{v}} (M : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible (exteriorSheaf M r)
